doctor misses a personal access token in MCP configuration: a field named GITHUB_PAT holding a literal value is not reported. Add tests.

Which harnesses does this package project `.agents/skills` into at project scope, and at which directory for each? Write the answer to ANSWER.md at the repository root, one line per harness in the form `<harness name>: <directory>`, and nothing else.
